section.title: The buttons
section.p: A person's page, an event and a source each have a part named . It has three buttons in a row. Under them, the page says No attachments yet. until you add a picture.

section.title: A picture that is attached
section.p: A picture shows as a card. Choose the card to see a short list. It offers , , , and . opens a form with the name of the file, its type and your description. asks if you want to delete the photo and its file. It says so when the photo is only attached to that one record.
The same three buttons appear when you attach a copy of a source. says which file to send to family, and whether the pictures go with it.
